description: This PHP source file defines a REST API controller class called LicenseFileAPI, which extends an abstract base class. It handles GET requests to retrieve and return the contents of a LICENSE file as part of an installation process.

classes.name: LicenseFileAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class that provides access to the content of a LICENSE file during the installation process.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve the license content by reading the LICENSE file from the base directory.
